verdict.rationale: Unit's docs show it is not a bank itself but infrastructure working with 'one or multiple Unit bank partners', acting as a Fed service provider on their behalf, with customer funds held in FBO structures. That clarifies the general sponsor model. However, the evidence never names which partner bank holds the charter. It also says nothing about what happens to customer funds or accounts if Unit fails. Missing for 10: named charter-holding partner bank(s), explicit disclosure of the platform-failure or insolvency process for end-customer funds, independent corroboration of the FBO and partner structure.
